name: Riviera Pacific Shopping Center
summary: Riviera Pacific Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail property located on Pacific Coast Highway in Redondo Beach, California. Managed by CBM1, a commercial real estate brokerage, the center serves the South Bay community with convenient retail and service offerings in a prime coastal location.
demographics: Riviera Pacific Shopping Center serves the affluent coastal community of Redondo Beach and surrounding South Bay areas, attracting middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary trade area consists of established families, young professionals, and retirees who value convenience and quality in their neighborhood shopping experiences. Visitors typically include local residents seeking everyday services and retail within a walkable distance from nearby residential neighborhoods, with a strong preference for accessible, convenient shopping options that serve daily needs.
description: Riviera Pacific Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination located at 1880 Pacific Coast Highway in the heart of Redondo Beach, California. Managed by CBM1, a leading Southern California commercial real estate brokerage specializing in leasing and investment sales, this shopping center serves the vibrant South Bay community with convenient access along the iconic Pacific Coast Highway. The center provides essential retail and service offerings to local residents and visitors exploring the Redondo Beach area. With its prime coastal location, Riviera Pacific Shopping Center benefits from the area's strong demographics and high traffic counts along one of California's most scenic coastal corridors. The property represents the type of well-positioned neighborhood retail asset that CBM1's veteran team of commercial real estate professionals specializes in managing and leasing, ensuring optimal tenant mix and property performance for investors and the surrounding community.
